source_spec.name: s81-dsfd-cfifo-colck-a6ca75fbe-tt-lvt-srcfix
source_spec.purpose: s81-die-2 2026-10-08: dsfd_cfifo --cfifo-colck (column side clocked from cr = its own column tree return; die sta_v6 FF class 70k < -100 = cfifo xa/xb launched at ck min 161 ps into the first column relays at co + tree ~450 ps; also the TT cf* ri capture class). Route at TC, mm hold FF, H1 + consistent link budget. 0 cycles (same register stages; meso read phase only). Record goes to views_colck (not adopted until the die STA uses it). Variant LVT (<=2% cells; the previous TC route was SS +14.9 / FF -17.75). | drive-2155: source -> a6ca75fbe (a6ca75fbe + the generated m221pq_colck/dsfd_cfifo.sv it lacked; bench rc=2 was a missing file) | Codex recovery: explicitly archive generated cfifo RTL required by bench and route; prior missing-source verdict preserved.

calibrate.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_die_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=8 GLUE=results/rtl/dsrom_s81_fulldie_20261004/m221pq_colck/dsfd_cfifo.sv DIE=m221pq_colck CFIFO_COLCK=1 OT_MULTI_VT=lvt SDCGEN=make_sdc_cfifo.sh POSTCTS=physical/s81_die_views/glue/post_cts_cfifo.tcl CLK=cr physical/s81_die_views/glue/route.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} dsfd_cfifo $CL_STOP_AFTER
calibrate.sdc_cmd: echo "route SDC regenerated by the route script from CK_SS_MEAN=$CK_SS_MEAN"

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_die_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=8 GLUE=results/rtl/dsrom_s81_fulldie_20261004/m221pq_colck/dsfd_cfifo.sv DIE=m221pq_colck CFIFO_COLCK=1 OT_MULTI_VT=lvt SDCGEN=make_sdc_cfifo.sh POSTCTS=physical/s81_die_views/glue/post_cts_cfifo.tcl CLK=cr physical/s81_die_views/glue/route.sh {LABEL} dsfd_cfifo

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record && cd {SRC} && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name dsfd_cfifo --out {RUN}/record --tmp-dir {RUN}/abs_tmp > {RUN}/record/export.log 2>&1; python3 tools/s81_die_view_ports.py check --die m221pq_colck --master dsfd_cfifo --lef {RUN}/record/dsfd_cfifo.lef > {RUN}/record/check.json; cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/args {RUN}/record/ && cp {CL}/calib.json {RUN}/record/calib.json

budget.reason: the sheet budgets each port at its worst die instance BEFORE the stations the coordinator asked for (link 558-980 um, field return / FIFO<->relay 450-864 um: added in the v6 die case), and models forwarded-clock station hops as full-cycle sync paths; these views are registered-at-pin (flop at every data pin), so the view IO uses 0.2 T against the measured insertion; re-signed against the regenerated sheet after v6
